peer.empty: No other installation is paired with this one yet

error.answer: The installation at {url} gave an answer that cannot be read
error.code: The pairing code is unknown, used or expired
error.customer: No customer of the calling installation has the external id {externalId} under {origin}
error.event: The delivery is not an event of the installation that signed it ({reason})
error.feed: The event feed answers the peer token of a link alone
error.handshake: {url} does not answer as an installation
error.header: The on-behalf header must read origin=name:instance; external_id=id
error.instance_key: The installation {instanceId} presents another instance key than the one pinned at pairing
error.level: The level {level} lies outside the range from service to {ceiling}
error.mask: {mask} is not a mask of names
error.no_url: The installation {instanceId} gave no address, so its tokens are rotated from its side
error.not_started: The peers module has not started
error.origin: The origin {origin} does not name the calling installation
error.paired: The installation {instanceId} is already paired with this one
error.principal: The link {id} names no principal that can be read
error.protocol: The other installation speaks protocol {protocol}, and this one supports {supported} and its neighbours
error.scope: A pairing may not grant more than the token of the caller holds
error.self: The address leads to this installation itself
error.signature: The delivery carries no valid signature of a paired installation
error.stored: The stored link {id} cannot be read
error.token: The peer token is unknown, retired or malformed
error.unreachable: The installation at {url} did not answer: {reason}
error.url: {url} is not an http or https address without credentials, query or fragment

peer.identity: Source of identity: apply its account and principal changes to the customers it synced here
peer.onBehalf: May act on behalf of customers

problem.instance_key: The installation at {url} presents another instance key than the one pinned for {instanceId}
problem.protocol: The installation at {url} speaks protocol {protocol}, which this one no longer understands with {supported}

peer.pull: Pull its events from its feed (this installation is behind NAT)
